text.body:
Title: *Mārajitstotra
Author: Harṣa
Source: Hahn 1996 (basically 2vs. from the Nāgānanda)
Tibetan: D 1117
|| bdud btul ba la bstod pa bzhugs | # || dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo ||
dhyānavyājam upetya cintayasi kām unmīlya cakṣuḥ kṣaṇam
paśyānaṅgaśarāturaṃ janam imaṃ trātāpi no rakṣasi |
mithyākāruṇiko 'si nirghṛṇataras tvattaḥ kuto 'nyaḥ pumān
serṣyaṃ māravadhūbhir ity abhihito bodhau jinaḥ pātu vaḥ || 1
bsam gtan phyin ci log gis ci zhig dgongs mdzad skad cig {63b1} legs par spyan dbye gzigs ||
lus med mda' yis gzir ba'i skye bo bdag cag skyob pas kyang ni bsrung bar mi mdzad na ||
thugs rje ldan pa phyin ci log gyur khyod las mchog tu ma rung skyes bu gzhan ma mchis ||
phrag dog ldan pa bdud kyi bud med de skad smra yang rgyal {63b2} ba skyob pa byang chub gyur ||
api ca |
gzhan yang
kāmenākṛṣya cāpaṃ hatapaṭupaṭahāvalgibhir māravīrair
bhrūbhaṅgotkampajṛmbhāsmitavalitadṛśā divyanārījanena |
siddhaiḥ prahvottamāṅgaiḥ pulakitavapuṣā vismayād vāsavena
dhyāyan bodher avāptāv acalita iti vaḥ pātu dṛṣṭo munīndraḥ || 2
'dod dbang gis ni kun du gzhu bkang bdud gzhan lag par myur pa pa Ta ha sgra 'jebs dang ldan ||
dpa' bo smin ma bskyod dang nyer g-yo lta bur sgeg dang 'dzum dang rol pa med rnams kyis ||
thub dbang skyob pa byang chub ma brnyes par {63b3} du bsam gtan las ni bskyod ma nus pa mthong gyur nas ||
ngo mtshar gyur pas pa spu langs pa'i lus kyis grub pa rnams dang yan lag mchog rnams 'dud ||
[?]
ral pa 'khrugs shing lce rnams g-yogs la kun du bltams pas gang gi thugs rnams 'khrul par ma gyur cing ||
rab {63b4} gsal 'dod lha'i bdud rnams rtse mo mchog dag lag thogs glang po rta rnams gdong ldan seng ge dang ||
stag gi gdong rnams rtsva bzhin grangs med gyur pa 'khor ba yis ni gang zhig bsnyengs par ma gyur pa ||
de ni kun la gnod pa'i rnam pa 'dres pa med par skyob pa sangs rgyas thub {63b5} dbang 'jig rten mgon ||
bdud btul ba la bstod pa | rab dga'i lha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so ||
